title: Bodycam Contradicts "Eyewitness" Statements in Controversial Shooting
description:
0:00 The Incident
3:20 Community Reaction
4:20 False Witness Statement Goes Viral

Video released by the Wisconsin Department of Justice shows the results of an investigation into an officer-involved shooting. This video contains substantial new developments and important updates into the investigation including details leading up to the encounter. We've presented the video with edits for educational and informational purposes.
